village_elder.name: Village Elder Mira
village_elder.description: Wise keeper of Oakrest Village. Worried about the wolves creeping too close to town.

dialogue.greeting: Traveler! The forest wolves grow bold. Will you thin their numbers?
dialogue.quest_offer: Hunt 3 Forest Wolves in Mosswood Forest and return to me.
dialogue.quest_active: The wolves still prowl. Return when 3 have fallen.
dialogue.quest_complete: You have done Oakrest a great service. Take this, and welcome.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith Dorn
blacksmith.description: Grizzled smith who sells basic gear to those who can pay.

dialogue.greeting: Need steel, traveler? I've wares for those with coin.
dialogue.shop: Take a look. Prices are fair.

ranger.name: Ranger Silas
ranger.description: Weathered hunter of the Hunter's Camp. Tracks the forest's threats and clears the caverns.

dialogue.greeting: The wolves are bold, and the caverns whisper of wisps. Need work, traveler?
dialogue.quest_offer: Clear the Thorn Wisps in the Whispering Caverns, then face the Cave Guardian.
dialogue.quest_active: The wisps still flicker. Return when the caverns are quiet.
dialogue.quest_complete: The caverns are safe. Take this, hunter.

merchant.name: Merchant Lira
merchant.description: Traveling trader who moves goods between Oakrest and the Hunter's Camp.

dialogue.greeting: Spare coin for wares, friend? Or perhaps you'd escort me safely to the camp?
dialogue.quest_offer: Escort me through the forest to the Hunter's Camp. Danger pays, traveler.
dialogue.quest_active: Stay close, traveler — the woods are not kind.
dialogue.quest_complete: Safe at last. Here's your share, friend.

innkeeper.name: Innkeeper Bram
innkeeper.description: Jolly keeper of The Restful Oak Inn. Knows every rumor in Oakrest.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome, traveler! A warm bed and a hot meal for a few coins.
dialogue.inn: Rest here and recover your strength.
